list.name: Changes
list.comment:
Add Vue.js framework and TypeIt library, implement dynamic content rendering
- Add Vue.js 3.5.30 production build for reactive component system - Add TypeIt 8.8.7 for animated typing effects on hero sections - Refactor all HTML pages to use Vue components and CDN-based architecture - Implement dynamic place details with image carousels and interactive maps - Add comprehensive Arabic translations with RTL support for all UI elements - Create reusable Vue components: Navbar, Sidebar, Hero, PlaceCard, PlaceDetails - Integrate Google Maps embeds for location display in place details - Update all category pages (khareef, deserts, coasts, ruins, natural-parks) with Vue structure - Enhance About page with animated hero section and technology showcase - Centralize places data in placesData.js module for better maintainability - Add settings modal with language, theme, and accent color customization - Implement responsive design improvements across all pages - Update navigation links to use relative paths without 'pages/' directory

task.summary: changing how svg is written to be more concise
adding lucide icons and customizing the navbar and sidebar with fixing some carousel issues.
Add settings modal with language/theme/accent customization and carousel translations
Add mobile responsive design to carousel and remove progress bar
Inline carousel data and add comprehensive Arabic translations with RTL support
Simplify settings modal by merging theme and accent color options
Implement full page structure with Vue components and settings modal for all category pages

Reformat JavaScript codebase with consistent indentation and add gallery components
- Reformat all JavaScript files from 4-space to tab indentation for consistency - Add PlacesGallery component with filterable place cards by category (khareef, deserts, coasts) - Add PlaceCard component with 3D hover effects and rating badges - Add PlaceDetails modal component with image carousel, map integration, and full descriptions - Reduce carousel slides from 6 to 3 (khareef, deserts, coasts) with updated translations - Update Sidebar to use base href-relative paths for all navigation links - Consolidate sidebar items into single array removing index/page path duplication - Add comprehensive place data including Wadi Darbat, Mughsail Beach, Jebel Samhan, and historical sites - Include bilingual (English/Arabic) support for all new components

Implement centralized i18n system with reactive translations and expand place data
- Create global i18n system in `js/i18n/index.js` with Vue reactive state and `window.t()` translation function - Add comprehensive translation keys for all UI elements (nav, carousel, settings, place details, sections) - Refactor all components to use `window.t()` instead of inline translation objects - Add `localechange` event system for reactive translation updates across components - Expand Gallery.js with 6 new Khareef places (Ayn Garzeez, Ayn Sahlanot, Iteen Park, Mughsail Beach, Naheez) including images and Google Maps embeds - Update ContentOverview.js to render place galleries dynamically from data - Add PlaceCategorySection.js component for reusable video hero sections - Implement "Explore More" section on index page with flexbox grid layout showcasing all categories - Update all page templates to load i18n system and sync with `window.i18n.setLocale()` - Add custom CSS animations (spin-slow, gradient) for enhanced UI effects - Create placeholder ruins.html page structure
Refactor explore section into reusable Vue components and add About page with hero and technologies sections
Extract preferences and theme management into shared services and mixin

Extract places data to centralized module and implement image carousel in place details
- Create PlacesData.js with comprehensive data for all categories (khareef, coasts, deserts, reserves, ruins) - Add structured place objects with bilingual names, descriptions, locations, and image galleries - Implement image carousel with navigation controls and slide indicators in ContentOverview component - Update Gallery component to use centralized PlacesData instead of inline data - Add PlacesData script import to all category pages (khareef, coasts, deserts, ruins) - Enhance place details modal with gallery slideshow functionality and improved image display

Add Natural Parks category page and integrate ruins section with translations
Implement dedicated Natural Parks page with full component structure, recategorize places data from 'reserves' to 'natural-parks', and add Ruins section to explore interface. Update i18n with Natural Parks and Ruins translations, enhance explore components with dynamic labels, and add theme-aware styling for explore section. Refactor theme service to use consistent 'theme' terminology and add locale change event dispatching for reactive component updates.
Refactor Vue components into modular structure and update CDN dependencies to specific versions

Update explore section styling and fix data inconsistencies
- Change ExploreCardLarge background image from khareef to about.webp - Update title and description colors to violet-500 and orange-200 - Add background images to ExploreCardSmall components (khareef, deserts, natural-parks, ruins) - Fix Wadi Darbat location from search URL to embedded map URL - Update About section translations to reference site author and technologies - Remove ZText from technologies list in AboutTechnologies component
